_comment: Copy to inferd.json (or point CANVAS_INFERD_CONFIG at it) to set the server-wide default inference backends. Users can override any space from the web UI; resolution is built-in default <- this file <- per-user config. Absent = CPU-local ONNX text + CLIP images. `providers` contains connection details, `spaces` selects the provider and model for each modality, and `rules` routes content into spaces. `match.contentType` accepts an exact string, a `type/*` prefix, or an explicit `/regex/flags`. Changing a space's model or dimensions creates a separate Lance table and ledger, so the previous model remains available until explicitly removed.
_rules_comment: Optional. Omit to keep built-in routing: notes, emails, and text files to text; images to image.
